tools.name: list_functions
tools.description: List the pricing functions registered for the authenticated tenant.

tools.name: browse_catalog

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: Report whether a price from compute_price was used. Pass receipt.id from that result as usage_event_id. Outcomes are what later routing and confidence learn from. With outcome pricing on, a rejection within the call's outcome window gives back part of what it cost; the result says what was refunded.

tools.name: get_price_guardrails
tools.description: Read the price guardrails saved for your workspace, and the defaults set_price_guardrails fills in for an omitted field. saved is false when none are saved, and then no workspace limit applies. Needs a Last Price credential with routing read scope.
